Name: Shrubs
Description: Group containing parameters for simulating the distribution and growth of shrubs (low plants) across the terrain. Behaves similarly to the Trees node but is specialized for low-lying vegetation.

Name: Count in Thousands
Description: Specifies the number of shrubs to generate, in thousands. Controls the overall density of shrubs across the terrain.

Name: Is Relative
Description: If enabled, the shrub count is relative to the terrain size or other factors, rather than being an absolute number.

Name: Shape
Description: Determines the shape or type of shrub clusters to be placed. Affects the visual appearance and distribution pattern of shrubs.

Flubs.Name: Point
Flubs.Description: Places individual shrubs as single points, resulting in a scattered, sparse distribution.

Flubs.Name: Big
Flubs.Description: Generates larger shrub clusters, simulating denser or more mature shrub growth.

Flubs.Name: BigOnly
Flubs.Description: Restricts placement to only large shrub clusters, omitting individual or small shrubs.

Name: Seed
Description: Sets the randomization seed for shrub placement, ensuring reproducible or varied results.

Name: Growth
Description: Group containing parameters that control the growth behavior and environmental response of shrubs.

Name: Seek Water
Description: Determines how shrubs respond to water sources, influencing their tendency to grow near or away from water.

Flubs.Name: Seek
Flubs.Description: Shrubs preferentially grow closer to water sources, increasing density near moist areas.

Flubs.Name: Avoid
Flubs.Description: Shrubs avoid water sources, resulting in sparser growth near moist areas.

Name: Avoid Trees
Description: Controls how shrubs interact with tree placement, affecting their distribution relative to trees.

Flubs.Name: None
Flubs.Description: Shrubs are placed without regard to tree locations.

Flubs.Name: Previous
Flubs.Description: Shrubs avoid areas where trees were previously placed, reducing overlap.

Flubs.Name: All
Flubs.Description: Shrubs avoid all tree-covered areas, ensuring no overlap between shrubs and trees.

Name: Health
Description: Represents the overall health or vigor of shrubs, affecting their size, density, and appearance.

Name: Spread
Description: Controls how far shrubs can spread from their initial placement, influencing patch size and coverage.

Name: Random
Description: Introduces randomness to shrub placement and growth, creating more natural and varied patterns.

Name: Simulation Bias
Description: Adjusts the simulation to favor certain environmental conditions or behaviors, influencing shrub distribution.

Name: Aspect Inhibition
Description: Group containing parameters that inhibit shrub growth based on terrain aspect, such as slope and altitude.

Name: Slope
Description: Limits shrub growth on steep slopes, simulating natural growth patterns where shrubs prefer gentler terrain.

Name: Slope Falloff
Description: Controls how quickly shrub density decreases as slope increases.

Name: Altitude
Description: Restricts shrub growth above or below certain altitudes, simulating elevation-based vegetation zones.

Name: Altitude Falloff
Description: Controls the rate at which shrub density decreases with altitude.

Name: Snow Inhibition
Description: Group containing parameters that inhibit shrub growth in snowy or snow-prone areas.

Name: Dead Flow
Description: Prevents shrub growth in areas with stagnant or 'dead' water flow, simulating natural avoidance of such regions.

Name: Consolidate Flows
Description: Encourages shrubs to grow along consolidated water flow paths, such as stream banks or drainage lines.

Name: Bias
Description: Applies a directional or environmental bias to shrub placement, favoring certain areas or conditions.

Name: Artistic Control
Description: Group containing parameters for fine-tuning shrub distribution and appearance for artistic purposes.

Name: Chaos
Description: Increases the irregularity and unpredictability of shrub placement, creating a more natural look.

Name: Blur Edges
Description: Softens the boundaries of shrub patches, blending them more smoothly into the surrounding terrain.

Name: Custom Inhibitors
Description: Group for user-defined rules or masks that inhibit shrub growth in specific areas.

Name: Custom Influence
Description: Allows custom input maps or masks to influence shrub placement and density.

Name: Trim
Description: Removes or reduces shrubs in specified areas, providing manual control over final distribution.
